name: MCP Gateway
description: A production-ready unified entry point for AI agents that implements the Model Context Protocol (MCP). It provides a secure gateway with rate limiting, authentication, and observability for managing and proxying requests to multiple downstream APIs.

rawRecord.description: A production-ready unified entry point for AI agents that implements the Model Context Protocol (MCP). It provides a secure gateway with rate limiting, authentication, and observability for managing and proxying requests to multiple downstream APIs.

GATEWAY_PORT.description: The port on which the gateway server will run.

GATEWAY_ENVIRONMENT.description: The environment the gateway is running in (e.g., development, production).

GATEWAY_AUTH_ENABLED.description: Determines if authentication is enabled for the gateway.

GATEWAY_API_KEYS_FILE.description: Path to the JSON file defining authorized API keys.

GATEWAY_UPSTREAM_CONFIG_FILE.description: Path to the JSON file defining upstream API configurations.

GATEWAY_RATE_LIMIT__DEFAULT_RPM.description: The default requests per minute allowed per identity.

GATEWAY_RATE_LIMIT__BURST_ALLOWANCE.description: The burst allowance for rate limiting.
